messages:
maya (ae): Quick sync 7 customer asking for POC orderform signature + KMS attestation attached. They want milestone billing: initial POC fee + go-live charge. Need esign routing and who signs.

_tim (sales-ops): Uploaded order form to drive: https://drive.internal/xf/poc-zenhealth. Amount = $22,500 initial, $7,500 on activation. POC = 45 days.

_omar (finance): For $22.5k we do sales-manager + finance reviewer. Need billing contact, tax ID, and PO number before invoicing. ACH or wire ok. Net30 is standard; Net45 needs director signoff.

_maya (ae): Buyer said they will attach a PO; they also asked for KMS attestation language: "keys remain under customer control, hardware-backed HSM in region EU-West". Can legal produce a short attestation we can attach?

_lina (legal): We can draft a KMS addendum one-liner: confirm key custody model + HSM statement. If they demand specific HSM vendor wording or certificate, route to infra. I'll prepare a short addendum and mark legal as reviewer in envelope.

_esign-bot: Found template: "OrderForm-PO-Milestones-v2". Default signing order = AE -> Customer -> Sales Manager -> Finance. Template link: https://docusign.internal/templates/OF-PO-v2. You can pass signOrder param to override.

_t改im (sales-ops): (typo) meant to say: I'll set signer order: AE (placeholder) -> Sales Manager -> Finance (attach PO) -> Customer exec -> Legal (review). Is that ok?

_lina (legal): Legal does not normally sign orderforms. Setting legal as a reviewer is fine. If the customer insists on legal signature, escalate. Also I need to see the exact PO terms; if PO references modifications to our SLA or data residency, we'll need to review prior to finalizing.

_omar (finance): Attaching PO to envelope is acceptable. Finance requires PO number in envelope metadata so AP can match. Also request: include separate line item for staged invoice in the invoice description.

_maya (ae): Buyer prefers single envelope with both orderform + KMS addendum attached so they sign everything at once. They might attach a supplier questionnaire as well.

_lina (legal): Drafted and uploaded KMS addendum: https://legal.internal/drafts/kms-attest-zenhealth-v1.docx. Minimal attestation with clause that "Redwood manages keys per customer region and offers HSM-backed key storage where requested". If they ask for HSM certificate we need infra to provide the artifact.

_tim (sales-ops): I'll prepare envelope when PO arrives. Plan: use template OF-PO-v2, override signOrder to ["ae","sales_mgr","finance_billing","customer_exec"], attach KMS addendum and PO, set envelope custom field "PO_NUMBER".

_omar (finance): Good. If billing wants a separate invoice for activation charge, we'll issue on milestone completion. We prefer invoice split but single orderform okay. Confirm whether legal needs to countersign the addendum or just be a reviewer.

_lina (legal): Reviewer only unless redlines show up. If buyer sends redlines on MSA/DPA referencing key custody, allow 24-48h for full review.

_maya (ae): I'll push buyer for PO tonight. ETA: PO by EOD. If we get it, Tim please send envelope and include buyer billing contact and tax ID.

_tim (sales-ops): Will do. I'll also attach an internal note to the envelope indicating "staged invoice schedule" and include accounting contact cc.

_maya (ae): Thanks team. I'll update thread when PO is in.

_tim (sales-ops): PO received and uploaded. Sending envelope now. :white_check_mark:

_lina (legal): Noted. I'll watch for any post-sign redlines.

_omar (finance): Received copy for AP. Invoice schedule ok.

_maya (ae): Envelope sent. Closing thread once signed. :rocket:
